sources.title: slmconsortium (Small Language Model Consortium) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Small Language Model Consortium (SLM Consortium) is an initiative dedicated to the advancement and betterment of the SLM community. We aim to promote cooperation, research, and development in the field of small language models.

sources.title: SAGE™ AI Model | Spharaka's Proprietary Cybersecurity SLM
sources.snippet: SAGE™ is Spharaka's proprietary AI model for autonomous cyber defence. A cybersecurity SLM fine-tuned on open foundation models using Spharaka's proprietary datasets, reasoning frameworks, and autonomous investigation technology.

sources.title: SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI
sources.snippet: SAGE-10k is a large-scale interactive indoor scene dataset featuring realistic layouts, generated by the agentic-driven pipeline introduced in "SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI". The dataset contains 10,000 diverse scenes spanning 50 room types and styles, along with 565K uniquely generated 3D objects.
